intent: Declare verified staging grains and complete column contracts; preserve daily traffic source counts and type empty annotations

edits.new_content:
select repository, repository_identity, source_revision, synced_at
from {{ source('raw', 'repositories') }}

version: 2
models:
- name: dim_repository
  columns:
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: repository_identity
    description: Stable GitHub repository ID when available, otherwise its configured name.
  - name: source_revision
    description: Full immutable Git SHA used to import this repository history.
  - name: synced_at
    description: UTC time when the pinned source was imported; not a source event date.
  description: One row per configured repository.
- name: fct_traffic
  columns:
  - name: traffic_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: clones_total
    description: GitHub clone operations for this UTC day; not installations.
  - name: clones_unique
    description: Daily unique cloner observations; not distinct people over a period.
  - name: views_total
    description: GitHub page views for this UTC day; may include automation.
  - name: views_unique
    description: Daily unique visitor observations; not distinct people over a period.
  - name: observed_days
    description: One per observed repository-day; a coverage count, not an imputation.
  description: One row per repository and observed UTC date. Counts pass through from the source.
- name: fct_observations
  columns:
  - name: observation_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: stars
    description: Repository star balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  - name: forks
    description: Repository fork balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  - name: observation_gap_days
    description: Days since the previous capture for this repository; null for its first capture.
  - name: stars_net_change
    description: Star balance difference only between consecutive captured UTC days; otherwise null.
  - name: forks_net_change
    description: Fork balance difference only between consecutive captured UTC days; otherwise null.
  description: Latest capture per repository and UTC date; daily changes require consecutive dates.
- name: fct_legacy
  columns:
  - name: legacy_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: stars
    description: Repository star balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  - name: forks
    description: Repository fork balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  description: One row per repository and historical source date; reconstructed balances carry forward
    within that repository.
- name: fct_referrer
  columns:
  - name: referrer_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: referrer
    description: Referring source ever reported in this repository endpoint.
  - name: views
    description: Reported views in one rolling snapshot window; null for an unreported item.
  - name: uniques
    description: Reported unique observations in one rolling snapshot; not additive across items.
  - name: reported_rank
    description: Rank among reported top-10 items; null if absent from the selected snapshot.
  - name: is_reported
    description: Whether this item was present in this exact successful snapshot; false is not zero traffic.
  description: One row per repository, latest daily referrer snapshot, and historically known referrer.
    Absent items retain null counts.
- name: fct_path
  columns:
  - name: path_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: path
    description: Repository path ever reported in this repository endpoint.
  - name: views
    description: Reported views in one rolling snapshot window; null for an unreported item.
  - name: uniques
    description: Reported unique observations in one rolling snapshot; not additive across items.
  - name: reported_rank
    description: Rank among reported top-10 items; null if absent from the selected snapshot.
  - name: is_reported
    description: Whether this item was present in this exact successful snapshot; false is not zero traffic.
  description: One row per repository, latest daily path snapshot, and historically known path. Absent
    items retain null counts.
- name: fct_snapshot_status
  columns:
  - name: snapshot_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: endpoint
    description: 'GitHub rolling snapshot endpoint: paths or referrers.'
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: source_file
    description: Original upstream snapshot filename for provenance.
  description: Latest successful snapshot per repository, endpoint, and UTC date; empty snapshots remain
    present.
- name: dim_event
  columns:
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: event_id
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: 'Stable source event identifier; manual annotations use the annotation: prefix in the
      event mart.'
  - name: event_date
    description: UTC event date used for association comparisons, not causal attribution.
  - name: kind
    description: Release or maintainer-supplied campaign/event category.
  - name: title
    description: Public release or annotation title.
  - name: url
    description: Optional public event URL; absence is valid.
  - name: prerelease
    description: Whether GitHub marks this release as a prerelease; false for manual annotations.
  description: One row per public release or annotated event. Comparisons establish association only.
- name: metricflow_time_spine
  time_spine:
    standard_granularity_column: date_day
  columns:
  - name: date_day
    granularity: day
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Continuous UTC day used by MetricFlow as its day-grain time spine.
  description: Continuous UTC calendar spanning the observed sources and a 28-day margin.
- name: stg_releases
  columns:
  - name: release_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: event_id
    description: 'Stable source event identifier; manual annotations use the annotation: prefix in the
      event mart.'
  - name: event_date
    description: UTC event date used for association comparisons, not causal attribution.
  - name: kind
    description: Release or maintainer-supplied campaign/event category.
  - name: title

  - name: url

  - name: prerelease

    \ imputation."
- name: stg_discovery

  - name: repository

  - name: endpoint

  - name: captured_at

  - name: item

  - name: views

  - name: repository

  - name: date

  - name: stars

  - name: forks

name: oss_analytics
version: 1.0.0
config-version: 2
profile: oss_analytics
model-paths:
- models
seed-paths:
- seeds
test-paths:
- data_tests
clean-targets:
- target
- dbt_packages
models:
  oss_analytics:
    staging:
      +materialized: view
    marts:
      +materialized: table
seeds:
  oss_analytics:
    annotations:
      +column_types:
        event_id: varchar
        repository: varchar
        event_date: date
        kind: varchar
        title: varchar
        url: varchar

-- Daily traffic is a source count, not a derived growth or balance measure.
select coalesce(f.repository, s.repository) as repository,
       coalesce(f.date, s.date) as date
from {{ ref('fct_traffic') }} f
full outer join {{ source('raw', 'traffic') }} s
  on f.repository = s.repository and f.date = s.date
where f.repository is null or s.repository is null
   or f.views_total is distinct from s.views_total
   or f.views_unique is distinct from s.views_unique
   or f.clones_total is distinct from s.clones_total
   or f.clones_unique is distinct from s.clones_unique
   or f.observed_days is distinct from 1
